prompt:
Create a clean transparent-background pixel-art reference atlas of exactly FOUR distinct small square cap objects in a strict 6-column by 4-row grid, 24 cells total. Columns from left to right are FRONT, TOP, RIGHT, LEFT, BOTTOM, REAR. Rows top to bottom correspond exactly to the four source objects shown in the primary source reference, in this order: (1) Battlefield reinforced north cap: square warm wood inset with four blue-black iron corner plates and rivets; (2) Battlefield reinforced west cap: same native wood/iron cap; (3) Larracos ancient city north cap: square weathered pale sandstone frame, teal inset surface, one central gold knob, red/orange corner stone accents in the source-specific positions; (4) Larracos ancient city west cap: same materials but keep its source-specific corner accents/orientation. The primary reference shows the actual native cap artwork; preserve each row's identity, material palette, details, counts, and ornament placement. The secondary contact is only a layout/scale aid; do not copy its erroneous thin bars or wrong Club motifs.

Every cell must show a coherent orthographic view of the SAME compact square cap, never perspective or isometric. For each cap, all four elevations FRONT/RIGHT/LEFT/REAR must have a common full square face width and common vertical thickness: a substantial square block, not a thin bar. The top is the source-supported decorated square plan, viewed straight down Z; the bottom is a square underside footprint viewed straight up, with no top-only knob repeated through opaque material. Show plausible material-faithful underside, no invented object. Side views show the cap's vertical block face and the top plane only as a narrow edge. TOP and BOTTOM have the same square XY footprint, with surface details logically occluded from below. Treat unseen faces conservatively as inferred, not recovered pixels. Center one object in every cell, keep a generous transparent margin, no clipping, no detached stray pixels or neighbor contamination. Make hard cell boundaries, consistent object scale per row, pixel-art texture and crisp dark outlines. Do not draw labels or grid lines. Transparent background.
qa_notes: generated_and_reviewed; rows 1-2 accepted for extraction; rows 3-4 rejected due alpha touching nominal row boundaries (clipped/contaminated).
